name: Klockmort's Essentials
summary: In Darnassus, Mathiel carries Klockmort Spannerspan's urgent plea across the sea. Bound to his post, he asks Alliance travelers to find his gnome friend in Ironforge.

sections.title: A Call Across Continents
sections.body: From the Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus, Mathiel sends word to Dun Morogh. Klockmort Spannerspan needs bold allies for a venture into Gnomeregan, but Mathiel cannot leave his post to travel there. So he asks capable Alliance travelers passing through Darnassus to make the journey in his place.

sections.title: The Road to Tinkertown
sections.body: Klockmort Spannerspan works in Tinkertown, Ironforge's district for gnomes driven from their underground city. He plans to recover vital machinery from Gnomeregan's contaminated corridors. Mathiel's referral brings you to Klockmort's workshop, where he needs help reclaiming what was left behind.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Klockmort's Essentials?
faq.answer: Mathiel gives the summons. The night elf cannot leave his post for Ironforge, so he asks trusted Alliance travelers to answer his longtime friend Klockmort Spannerspan's plea.

faq.q: Where do I find Klockmort Spannerspan?
faq.answer: Find Klockmort Spannerspan in Tinkertown, Ironforge's gnomish district. Gnomes displaced from their lost home have set up workshops and equipment there.

faq.q: Why does Klockmort need help in Gnomeregan?
faq.answer: Klockmort needs help retrieving essential mechanical components from Gnomeregan. Toxic fallout overran the city, and its ruins hold troggs, deranged leper gnomes, and haywire automata.

faq.q: Is this quest required to enter Gnomeregan?
faq.answer: No. Mathiel's summons leads you to Klockmort Spannerspan, but you can speak with him in Ironforge and accept his assignments without the introduction.
After you speak with Klockmort Spannerspan, he directs you to Essential Artificials. It sends you deep inside Gnomeregan.

faq.q: Why is Mathiel interested in helping a gnome in Ironforge?
faq.answer: Mathiel and Klockmort are longtime personal friends. Though stationed far away and unable to leave his post, Mathiel seeks someone trustworthy to help his friend.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you carry Mathiel's appeal from Darnassus to Klockmort in Ironforge. Night elf lands and dwarven halls join in common defense.
As a gnome, you know every call to Tinkertown aids the ongoing struggle to reclaim your lost home of Gnomeregan.
